question: Why do two full-core Dell R7725/AMD EPYC9755 records differ with the same CPU, memory capacity/speed and compiler?

records.power_management: BIOS and OS prefer performance at additional power usage

interpretation: 18.3% difference is not run-to-run noise estimate or a causal estimate of power mode alone: firmware settings/OS and test setup differ. Both are valid system results. Do not use all-record median as CPU-only value or performance-per-watt inference. The throughput-favoring run has no matched energy score.
decision: Keep public SPEC data as a caution/competitive diagnostic, not direct Intel ASP or retained-profit evidence. CPU2017 and CPU2026 scores are never pooled.
